services.name: Nature & Lobstering Tour
services.desc: Learn about Maine's fishing industry and wildlife, haul a few lobster traps, and take in the incomparable beauty of the Maine coast! Duration 2 hours About Enjoy nature at its best! Cruise past Bass Harbor Head Lighthouse and experience the outer islands of Blue Hill Bay up close and personal– from ledges where seals sun and swim, to small islands with nesting birds and ducks. When the porpoise are running or the eagles are hunting, we’ll be sure to stop to give our passengers a real treat! Due to Coast Guard regulation our passenger count must include all souls on board, tickets are required. Seating is general admission. services.name: Sailboat Charter
services.desc: Enjoy one of the finest sailing destinations, and views and wildlife of Acadia National Park aboard our beautiful 36’ sailboat, Motu Iti (“Little Island” in Rapa Nui)! Dates and times Dates: beginning mid June through September Tour Times daily About When you charter Motu Iti, the boat and our experienced, knowledgeable charter Captain are yours for the duration. Sailing is a great way to experience the coast of Maine. Whether it’s sightseeing and wildlife, or learning to sail for the first time, we make sure you have the best trip possible, tailored to your interests. Boat holds 6 people

blurb: Island Cruises offers boat tours and charters from Bass Harbor, Maine, providing wildlife viewing, fishing, sailing, and sightseeing experiences around Acadia National Park and Blue Hill Bay. Guests can see seals, eagles, porpoises, puffins, and lighthouses while learning about Maine's fishing industry and local history. Private charters are available for customized trips on sailboats or power boats for small groups.
